newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 3.64 million barrels in the week ended Feb 7 to 299.47 million barrels from 295.83 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 5.33 million barrels in the week to 232.64 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 4.92 million barrels to 110.61 million from 115.53 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.05 million barrels to 41.42 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 301,000 barrels in the week to 7.04 million bpd from 7.34 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 3.36 million barrels in the week to 207.56 million barrels from 204.20 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 87.6 percent from 90.3 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 200,000 barrels to 38.59 million barrels from 38.79 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 13.24 million barrels from 13.71 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 43.36 million barrels from 43.50 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.89 million barrels per day from 7.14 million, API said.
